headline: State Bank of Pakistan Launches SMEConnect Digital Loan Platform
summary: The State Bank of Pakistan introduced SMEConnect, a centralized digital portal designed to standardize and streamline credit application procedures for small and medium-sized enterprises nationwide.
why: Credit access for SMEs in Pakistan has historically been hampered by high documentation hurdles, leaving significant portions of the private sector unbanked.

impacts.name: Pakistani Banking Sector
impacts.why: A single centralized portal lowers origination costs and facilitates SME loan distribution across banks.
